details: Citadel Securities suggests the Federal Reserve may need to raise interest rates soon due to persistent inflation pressures, strong labor markets, and elevated energy costs. This comes ahead of the US CPI and PPI data this week, with higher-than-expected readings potentially leading to tighter monetary policy and negative impacts on risk assets, including cryptocurrencies. Markets are currently pricing in a 70% chance of a quarter-point rate increase by December.
title: US Inflation Fears Drive Fed Rate Hike Speculation

details: Crude oil prices fell, and the dollar eased after Iran and Israel agreed to halt attacks against each other, boosting hopes for peace negotiations. This de-escalation of tensions in the Middle East has reduced safe-haven demand for the greenback and could alleviate some pressure on global financial markets and risk assets.
title: Geopolitical Tensions Ease as Iran and Israel Halt Attacks

details: Bitcoin steadied after briefly dropping below $60,000, recovering to around $63,400. This stabilization follows comments from MicroStrategy Chairman Michael Saylor, who hinted at further Bitcoin purchases, helping to calm trader concerns. The recovery comes in the context of significant institutional selling through US-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs, which have seen approximately $5.4 billion in net redemptions since mid-May.
title: Bitcoin Stabilizes After Dip, Saylor Hints at More Buys Amid ETF Outflows
